about.title: About Loopy Timer
about.intro: Loopy Timer is a free interval timer for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM, Pomodoro and your own cycles. Run several timers at the same time, right in your browser. No sign-up, no install.
about.feature1: Several timers running at once, each with its own work / rest cycle
about.feature2: Presets for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM and Pomodoro, or build your own
about.feature3: Sound cues, saved timers and offline use as an installable web app
about.feature4: Share your finished workout or focus session as text or an image
faq.a1: Yes. It is free to use, needs no account and runs in your browser.
faq.q2: Can I run more than one timer at once?
faq.a2: Yes. Add as many timers as you like and start them independently, for example a Tabata set and a Pomodoro session side by side.
faq.a3: Timers are saved in your browser, so they come back after a reload. Your timers are never uploaded. You can also add the app to your home screen and use it offline.
seo.title: Loopy Timer – Free Interval, Tabata, HIIT & Pomodoro Timer
seo.description: Free online interval timer for Tabata, HIIT, EMOM and Pomodoro. Run multiple timers at once, build your own work / rest cycles and share your results. No sign-up.
edit.linkCopied: Link copied. Anyone who opens it can add this timer.
preset.about.pomodoro: The Pomodoro Technique alternates 25 minutes of focused work with 5-minute breaks. This timer starts at 25 min work / 5 min rest × 4 rounds, and you can change it any time.
preset.about.tabata: Tabata is a high-intensity interval format: 20 seconds of all-out effort and 10 seconds of rest, repeated 8 times (4 minutes). This timer adds a 10-second get-ready countdown.
preset.about.hiit: A simple HIIT plan: 40 seconds of hard work and 20 seconds of rest, 10 rounds per set, 2 sets with a 1-minute break in between. Adjust the times to your level.
preset.about.emom: EMOM means “every minute on the minute”: work for 45 seconds, rest for 15, and start the next round on the minute. This timer runs 10 rounds.
